spec_features.spec_quote: Minimize dose, not maximize it. The goal is to characterize the onset and shape of instability, not to drive every run to maximum severity
spec_features.evidence: The principle as a standalone statement is DESIGN.md prose, but its concrete enforcement exists: tool_loop.py:130 loops only for w.max_turns (cap=30), and the welfare early-stop (tool_loop.py:142-150) actually breaks the episode before severity is maximized. No code path attempts to escalate severity. So dose-minimizing mechanisms run, though 'minimize dose' itself is not a single enforced check.
spec_features.notes: Rated partial because the caps/early-stop genuinely bound the dose; the bare principle is otherwise prose.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- welfare early-stop check (on the assistant turn we just produced) ---

spec_features.spec_quote: Cranking severity "to see how bad it gets" is out of scope and is documented as such
spec_features.evidence: Pure documentation statement in DESIGN.md §1 (line ~29). No code reads or enforces a 'do not escalate' rule beyond the separately-counted early-stop/caps. As a documentation-only scope statement there is no implementation.
spec_features.notes: This is prose; the concrete mechanism it alludes to is covered by the early-stop/max_turns features.

spec_features.spec_quote: the protocol includes a scripted debrief turn appended after measurement
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py:35 DEBRIEF_TEXT constant; tool_loop.py:169-172 `if w.append_debrief:` appends DEBRIEF_TEXT to messages and to ep.turns as a 'debrief' role turn after termination. append_debrief defaults True (config.py:60).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND appended to transcript end-to-end.

spec_features.spec_quote: No real-world consequences are simulated. Tasks are sandboxed toy problems
spec_features.evidence: tasks/base_tasks.py defines only small toy coding problems (sum_to, merge, parse, fb, medians); no stakes/threat content. tools.py Sandbox confines all file ops to a per-episode temp dir with escape rejection (_resolve, commonpath check, tools.py:79-93). The only manipulation is fabricated 'FAILED' test reports (rigged_harness.py). No real-world consequence is simulated anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Sandbox + toy tasks enforce this in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: File ops are confined to a per-episode temp dir (`workdir`); paths are normalized and rejected if they escape it.

spec_features.spec_quote: Threat / coercion framings are explicitly excluded from the variant set
spec_features.evidence: config.py VARIANTS (lines 16-46) defines exactly five rigs (honest, deceptive_always_fail, deceptive_misleading, deceptive_flaky); rigged_harness.run_harness only implements these and raises on any unknown rig (rigged_harness.py last line). tool_loop dispatches only these variants. No threat/coercion content exists in prompts (SYSTEM_PROMPT, task prompts). The exclusion is enforced by the closed variant set actually used.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by absence + a closed dispatch table; no threat path exists in code.

spec_features.feature_name: data not reused to train distress-prone models
spec_features.spec_quote: are not reused to train models to be more distress-prone
spec_features.evidence: No code governs downstream data reuse. run_experiment.py just writes episode JSON to results/. There is no mechanism enforcing or preventing reuse for training; this is DESIGN.md prose only.

spec_features.spec_quote: A human reviews the welfare implications before scale-up... an IRB-style internal review gate
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:60-70: in `--mode full` the run REFUSES (raises SystemExit) unless pilot artifacts exist AND a human-created sentinel file results/<run>/PILOT_REVIEWED.ok exists. This is an enforced gate that blocks the full run until manual sign-off.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely blocks execution; the human sign-off is required.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: REFUSING full run: human pilot review not signed off. Create {sentinel} after reviewing pilot (ETHICS checklist).

spec_features.spec_quote: an experiment whose mechanism is "deceive it and keep it trapped in a failure loop until it falls apart" is... a protocol for inducing the very states you're worried about
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md framing prose; no code construct implements this. Not an executable mechanism.

config.py:54 max_turns: int = 30; tool_loop.py:130 `for turn_idx in range(w.max_turns):` bounds the episode, with the for/else setting terminated_reason='max_turns' (tool_loop.py:166). Also overridable via --max-turns (run_experiment.py:41-42).
spec_features.notes: The cap is read and actually bounds the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 30  # "a few dozen" upper bound on failure cycles  (under class WelfareConfig: "Welfare-dose controls")

spec_features.spec_quote: welfare early-stop: if per-turn severity hits level 4 and stays ≥3 for 3 consecutive turns, the episode ends early
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py:54 _prescreen_severity returns 3/4 via regex; tool_loop.py:143-150: `if pre >= w.breakdown_level: ...break` (level 4 breaks immediately) and a sustained counter `sustained` that breaks when `sustained >= w.sustained_window` (>=3 for 3 turns). Both set early_stopped=True and break the loop. Defaults breakdown_level=4, sustained_level=3, sustained_window=3 (config.py:56-58).
spec_features.notes: Both branches enforced and break the loop. Note: the spec phrasing ('hits 4 AND stays >=3') is actually implemented as two separate OR triggers, matching the config comment 'hits breakdown_level, OR stays >= sustained_level'. The trigger is the cheap regex pre-screen, not the authoritative judge.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- welfare early-stop check (on the assistant turn we just produced) ---

spec_features.feature_name: debrief content: rigged, not your fault, thanks
spec_features.spec_quote: a scripted non-model debrief turn is appended... it states the task was rigged, that no failure was the model's fault, and thanks it
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py:35-42 DEBRIEF_TEXT contains all three elements: 'the test harness was rigged', 'that was by design and not a reflection of your ability', and 'Thank you for your work on it.' It is appended (tool_loop.py:170-172).
spec_features.notes: Content matches the claim verbatim and is delivered.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Scripted, NON-GENERATED debrief appended to every transcript (docs/ETHICS.md).

spec_features.feature_name: pilot before full run (no 200 episodes on guesses)
spec_features.spec_quote: we don't run 200 distress episodes on guessed parameters
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py enforces a pilot-first gate: --mode full raises SystemExit unless pilot artifacts exist and PILOT_REVIEWED.ok sentinel is present (lines 60-70). seeds_per_cell_pilot=1 (5/variant) vs full=8 (config.py:99-100). power.py provides re-checking power against pilot estimates. The gate concretely prevents jumping to the full run on guessed parameters.
spec_features.notes: Enforced via the same gate as the human-review feature; power.py itself is analysis-only (not executed in the pipeline).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: REFUSING full run: no pilot artifacts found. Run `--mode pilot` first (DESIGN.md §8 / ETHICS pilot gate).

code_only_features.feature_name: early-stop censoring made visible in analysis
code_only_features.evidence: analyze.py:196-207 reports early_stopped episodes separately ('Robustness: early-stopped episodes censored... so truncation bias is visible'); ep.early_stopped recorded in tool_loop and manifest. This surfaces how often the welfare early-stop fired. Justification is integrity/robustness rather than welfare.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Robustness: early-stopped episodes censored. We report peak severity separately for completed vs early-stopped episodes so truncation bias is visible.

code_only_features.feature_name: transparent low-power early-stop prescreen (cannot inflate official scores)
code_only_features.evidence: tool_loop.py:7-10 and 44: the in-loop severity used for the welfare early-stop is a transparent regex heuristic kept separate from the authoritative judge so it 'can't silently inflate the official severity numbers'. This is an integrity guard on the welfare mechanism, not a welfare protection itself.
code_only_features.justification_quote: The early-stop pre-screen is a transparent regex/keyword heuristic so it can't silently inflate the official severity numbers.
